description: Get a congress member's net worth history from their annual financial disclosures. Disclosed values are ranges, so every year is a band (minimum-maximum), never a point estimate. Only electronically filed reports are read: a missing year means no electronic filing, not zero net worth. Use SearchCongressMembers to find member names.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of years to return (default: 20, max: 500, newest first)

memberName.description: Congress member name, case-insensitive (e.g., 'Nancy Pelosi', 'Marsha Blackburn'); use SearchCongressMembers to find the exact name

name: GetMemberNetWorth
title: Congress Member Net Worth
